maya: I merged PR #4567 ~2m ago, main CI went red on smoke-gpu-matrix. Anyone can grab? @oncall ping
ci-bot: pipeline failed: smoke-gpu-matrix @main - job https://ci.redwood/internal/ci/builds/12345 - step `smoke_gpu_test` exited 1 - failing test: `tests/integration/test_kvalloc.py::test_prefix_cache`
jon: link to build please? can someone paste the failing log snippet
maya: https://ci.redwood/internal/ci/builds/12345
log excerpt:
```
E       AssertionError: kvalloc size mismatch
E       assert 0 == 1
  File "tests/integration/test_kvalloc.py", line 78, in test_prefix_cache
```
Seems to blow up in the allocator path during kernel init
lee: I can eyeball quickly. I'll try a rerun first — might be a transient. @ci-bot rerun build 12345
ci-bot: rerun queued by lee: build 12345 -> build 12346
sam: if rerun fails we should bisect. @jon can you run a quick bisect if needed?
jon: available, will start bisect if 12346 fails. Also tagging infra-owners: who touched the allocator/kernel scheduler around these commits?
maya: PR #4567 touched the allocator shim + torch backend init. cc @lee @jon for context
ci-bot: rerun build 12346 started... status: running
lee: rerun passed on 12346 :tada: logs show no kvalloc assert, appears transient. I'll keep monitoring for 10m
maya: thanks. Can we mark this test flaky and open a follow-up to add a retry? don't want late-night wakeups
jon: ack. I'll add `tests/integration/test_kvalloc.py::test_prefix_cache` to flaky-tests.yaml and open an issue linking PR #4567 and the build logs
maya: assign to jon, thanks. If it flaps again we'll initiate bisect
sam: :thumbsup: if it recurs consider a temporary revert of PR #4567 while bisecting
ci-bot: note: pipeline had ~2m extra queue time than baseline this run — could be infra jitter
lee: leaving a short comment on PR #4567 and tagging release-watch so folks know we saw a transient failure
